description: Review one VFX clip (video or GIF) like a lead artist: frame strip, greyscale strip, energy curve, timing, white burn-out, contrast, flicker, loop seam, and scores with frame-tied fixes on rng-vfx's six qualities; optional reference to compare. Price: $0.20 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of VFX review: Reviews a game effect the way a lead VFX artist would: a numbered frame strip and a greyscale strip, the energy curve, measured timing (arrival, hold, dissipation), white burn-out, value contrast and flicker, and scores with frame-tied notes on the six qualities of rng-vfx.

brief.description: What the effect is meant to be, e.g. "heavy sword hit on an armoured enemy".

clip.description: One effect as a video or GIF, base64 (mp4, webm, mov, gif), up to 20 s.

loop.description: true for looping effects (auras, fire, idle glow): checks the seam instead of the dissipation.

reference.description: Optional reference clip (base64) to compare against side by side.

style.description: The rng-vfx style it should match: realism, stylized (MOBA), anime, toon, dark-fantasy, pixel.

name: vfx_review
